formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO (MW=400,000, Aldrich) complexed with LiClO4, LiI, or LiCF3SO3 at EO/Li ratios of 9, 12, 15, 18; solution cast from acetonitrile, vacuum dried (0.01 mbar) at 60°C for 36 h to free-standing films.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Ea (Eσ) for dc conductivity from least-squares Arrhenius fit (Table II), ±0.01 eV. Corresponding activation energy for ac crossover frequency (Ec) reported as 1.21 eV (±0.02), in close agreement, supporting common hopping barrier for dc and ac relaxation.
formulations.Notes: This composition (EO/Li=9) had the lowest crystalline peak intensity and smoothest surface (XRD Fig.1a, SEM Fig.2/3, DSC Table I), identified by authors as most amorphous and highest-conductivity electrolyte among all studied. XRD peaks at ~19°, ~24° 2θ were table-digitized (approximate) and consistent across all compositions/salts, not usable for quantitative crystallinity comparison.
formulations.Reference: Karmakar, A.; Ghosh, A. J. Appl. Phys. 2010, 107, 104113.
